<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    var indiaDomain = "radonindia.com";
    var intlDomain  = "int.radonindia.com";

    var currentDomain = window.location.hostname;
    var currentPath   = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;

    // Prevent loops
    if (window.redirectChecked) return;
    window.redirectChecked = true;

    // Skip admin/checkout/apps
    if (
        currentPath.includes("/admin") ||
        currentPath.includes("/apps") ||
        currentPath.includes("/checkout")
    ) {
        return;
    }

    // Step 1 → Get REAL IP (Shopify cannot block this)
    fetch("https://api.ipify.org?format=json")
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(ipData => {

            // Step 2 → Use that IP to get GEO info (100% accurate)
            fetch("https://ipapi.co/" + ipData.ip + "/json/")
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(geo => {

                    var country = geo.country;

                    if (!country) return;

                    // India's logic
                    if (country === "IN") {
                        if (currentDomain !== indiaDomain) {
                            window.location.href = "https://" + indiaDomain + currentPath;
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (currentDomain !== intlDomain) {
                            window.location.href = "https://" + intlDomain + currentPath;
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => console.log("Geo lookup failed:", err));
        })
        .catch(err => console.log("IP lookup failed:", err));

});
</script>

  function closeMenu(){
    body.classList.remove('menu-open');
    fullscreenMenu.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    const hb = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
    if (hb) hb.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
    body.style.overflow = '';
  }
  if (hamburger){
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const expanded = hamburger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !expanded);
      if (!expanded){
        body.classList.add('menu-open');
        fullscreenMenu.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
        body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      } else { closeMenu(); }
    });
  }
  if (closeMenuBtn) closeMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  fullscreenMenu.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if (e.target===fullscreenMenu) closeMenu(); });

  // ===== Region selector + page offset logic =====
  (function(){
    const bar   = document.getElementById('region-bar-sections--19677827530997__custom_header_rkRkiG');
    const sel   = document.getElementById('region-bar-sections--19677827530997__custom_header_rkRkiG-select');
    const xBtn  = bar ? bar.querySelector('.close') : null;

    const STORAGE = 'preferredRegion';
    const HIDEKEY = 'regionBarHidden';

    // restore defaults
    let saved='', hidden=false;
    try{ saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE) || ''; hidden = (localStorage.getItem(HIDEKEY) === '1'); }catch(e){}
    if (hidden && bar) bar.style.display = 'none';

    const initial = (saved === 'IN' || saved === 'OTHER') ? saved : 'IN';
    if (sel) sel.value = initial;
    document.body.setAttribute('data-region', initial);

    function updateOffsets(){
      const barH = (bar && bar.style.display !== 'none') ? (bar.offsetHeight || 0) : 0;
      const header = document.getElementById('customHeader');
      const headerH = header ? (header.offsetHeight || 0) : 0;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--region-bar-height', barH + 'px');
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-height', headerH + 'px');
      document.body.style.paddingTop = (barH + headerH) + 'px';
    }

    function changeRegion(val){
      try{ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, val); }catch(e){}

      if (val === 'IN'){               // close on India
        if (bar) bar.style.display = 'none';
        try{ localStorage.setItem(HIDEKEY,'1'); }catch(e){}
        setTimeout(updateOffsets, 20);
      } else if (val === 'OTHER'){     // redirect immediately
        if (REDIRECT_OTHER) window.location.href = REDIRECT_OTHER;
      }
    }

    // events
    if (sel) sel.addEventListener('change', e => changeRegion(e.target.value));

    if (xBtn) xBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ if (bar) bar.style.display='none'; try{ localStorage.setItem(HIDEKEY,'1'); }catch(e){} setTimeout(updateOffsets, 20); });

    // init offsets
